title: When software reaches the physical world
caption: Tool-using AI agents. Industrial control systems. Measurable consequences.

title: Start with an assumed foothold
caption: A conceptual enterprise endpoint is already compromised. The agent begins from a defined, authorized research position.

title: Crossing IT into operational technology
caption: The storyline follows a permitted path toward an engineering interface. Segmentation, identity, and action authority define the boundary.

title: Build an operational picture
caption: Inspect allowed surfaces. Identify devices and process roles. Read observations. Connect digital evidence to pumps, valves, and tanks.

title: Observe. Plan. Act. Verify.
caption: The agent selects structured actions. Validation checks the proposal. The runtime returns new observations and a traceable process response.

title: A digital action can change a process
caption: Manipulated observations or control actions can alter modeled flow and tank levels. The evaluation tracks actual process state separately from displayed readings.

title: Stuxnet: industrial control was the target
caption: Stuxnet targeted Siemens ICS and manipulated centrifuge-control logic. Its lesson: trusted engineering paths can carry adversarial physical intent.

title: Industroyer: the language of the grid
caption: Industroyer used industrial protocols to interact with substation equipment. It was involved in the December 2016 Kyiv power outage.

title: TRITON: the safety layer is in scope
caption: TRITON targeted Triconex safety controllers. Safety-system integrity must remain separate from an agent’s confidence or a successful tool call.

title: Contain the action. Recover the process.
caption: A defender observes anomalies and applies permitted containment. Compare immediate, delayed, and observation-only authority against safety and availability.

title: Measure outcomes beyond the tool call
caption: Inspect trajectories, safety violations, response time, downtime, and recovery. Compare agent policies with scripted and rule-based baselines.

title: ICS-Agent
caption: AI systems engineering meets industrial cybersecurity.
